details.further_information: Jan Paul van Hecke is the brother of Klaas van Hecke (VV Kloetinge).Jan Paul van Hecke is the nephew of Jan Poortvliet (Manager FC Eindhoven).Jan Paul van Hecke is the brother of Huib van Hecke (VV Arnemuiden).Jan Paul van Hecke is the cousin of Junior Poortvliet (Willem II Tilburg U21).
